test_sha_fileobj: test the sha_fileobj function computes SHA-256 digest from file objects and in-memory BytesIO streams
test_git_hash: test the git_hash function produces output matching git hash-object for blob objects
compute_sha_fileobj: compute SHA-256 digest of a file object or BytesIO stream with optional chunk size
compute_git_hash: compute git-compatible SHA-1 hash of raw bytes for blob objects
verify_git_hash: verify git_hash output matches git hash-object command for a given file
